name: DDO 52 (Hubble)
blurb: DDO 52, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ddo52-hubble
story: DDO 52 is a small, irregular galaxy, one of the dwarfs studied by the LITTLE THINGS survey to learn how stars form in such tiny systems.

claims.text: DDO 52 is also called PGC 23769 and UGC 4426
DDO 52 is a LITTLE THINGS dwarf irregular galaxy
LITTLE THINGS is a survey of dwarf irregular and blue compact dwarf galaxies
